name: Index YouTube Playlist
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *' # Daily at midnight
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  index-youtube:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'
          
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci
        
      - name: Run YouTube indexing
        run: |
          npx tsx scripts/index-youtube-playlist.ts
        env:
          YOUTUBE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.YOUTUBE_API_KEY }}
          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
          VECTORIZE_NAMESPACE_ID: ${{ secrets.VECTORIZE_NAMESPACE_ID }}
          R2_BUCKET_NAME: ${{ secrets.R2_BUCKET_NAME }}
          YOUTUBE_PLAYLIST_ID: ${{ secrets.YOUTUBE_PLAYLIST_ID }}
          YOUTUBE_CAPTIONS_ENABLED: ${{ secrets.YOUTUBE_CAPTIONS_ENABLED }}
